chapters.title: Unit 1: Let's make friends! Lesson 1: Hello! I'm Clare. What's your name?

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 1, упр. 1, с. 6. Послушай и прочитай рассказы детей о себе; ответь на вопросы; расскажи о себе.
steps: 1) The girl's name is Clare. The boy's name is Paul.
2) Clare is from England. Paul is from Devon, England.
3) Clare's hobby is playing games — Scrabble and Monopoly. Paul's hobby is riding horses.
4) I'm Maria. I'm eleven years old. I'm from Russia. I have got a cat. My hobby is drawing.
problems.answer: Клэр и Пол из Англии; хобби — игры и лошади; рассказ о себе

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 1, упр. 2, с. 7. Рассмотри семьи Клэр и Пола (с. 5). AB 1.1–1.2: кто кем приходится. 2) Расскажи о семье от лица Пола.
steps: AB 1.1: Jay is Clare's brother. Steve is Jay and Clare's dad. Ann is their mum.
AB 1.2: Oliver is Paul's brother. Alice is Paul's grandma. Philip is Paul's grandpa.
2) My family is big. I have got a sister and a brother. My mum's name is …, my dad's name is …
problems.answer: Родственные связи + рассказ о семье Пола

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 1, упр. 3, с. 7. Разыграй диалог о знакомстве по ролевым карточкам.
steps: Pupil 1: What is your name? — Pupil 2: My name is Alexei. — Pupil 1: How old are you? — Pupil 2: I'm eleven. — Pupil 1: Where are you from? — Pupil 2: I'm from Moscow. — Pupil 1: What's your hobby? — Pupil 2: Football.
problems.answer: Диалог-знакомство: What's your name? How old are you? Where are you from?

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 1, упр. 4, с. 7. AB 1 (с. 120): начни портфолио «All about me» — семейное древо и рассказ.
steps: Family tree: Max (me), Svetlana (mum), Mikhail (dad), Denis (brother), Tatyana (grandma), Ivan (grandpa).
I'm Max. My family is not big. I have got a brother. My mum is a doctor, my dad is an engineer.
problems.answer: Семейное древо + короткий рассказ

chapters.title: Unit 1: Let's make friends! Lesson 2: What do you do in your spare time?

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 2, упр. 1, с. 8. Британские дети занимаются разными активностями. Скажи, чем они занимаются в свободное время.
steps: British children swim in the pool, ride horses, go on trips, have picnics, do difficult puzzles, take photos, ride bikes, play tennis and board games, watch TV.
problems.answer: swim, ride horses, go on trips, have picnics, do puzzles, take photos, ride bikes

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 2, упр. 2, с. 8. 1) Какими активностями занимаются Клэр, Меган и Пол? 2) Чем ещё они занимаются? 3) Чем занимаешься ты?
steps: 1) Clare rides a bike with her friend, swims in the pool and does difficult puzzles. Paul rides horses and takes pictures. Megan goes on trips.
2) Clare and Megan play tennis, go for walks, play board games and watch TV. Paul listens to music and goes to the cinema.
3) Clare plays tennis. — I play tennis too. / I don't play tennis. Clare swims in the pool. — I swim in the pool too.
problems.answer: Занятия ребят; I … too / I don't …

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 2, упр. 3, с. 9. 1) Что семья Клэр делает вместе? 2) Как твоя семья проводит время вместе?
steps: 1) My family and I do a lot of things together. We often watch TV, go for walks and play board games. On Sundays we visit our grandparents.
2) I usually spend weekends with my family. We clean the house together, cook dinner and watch films. In summer we go to the country.
problems.answer: Семья Клэр вместе смотрит TV, гуляет; своя семья — уборка, ужин, фильмы

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 2, упр. 4, с. 9. В парах узнайте, чем занимается партнёр в свободное время.
steps: What do you do in your free time? What is your hobby? Do you play any games? Do you go for walks with friends? What do you do at weekends?
problems.answer: Вопросы о свободном времени партнёра

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 2, упр. 5, с. 9. Игра: найди одноклассников со схожими интересами.
steps: What books do you read? Do you do sports? Do you like computer games? Do you play a musical instrument? Do you collect anything?
Записываем имена тех, у кого ответы совпали с твоими.
problems.answer: Опрос класса и поиск совпадений

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 2, упр. 6, с. 9. AB 2 (с. 121): что вы делаете вместе в семье. Reader 1: статья о любимых шоу американских детей. AB 1 (с. 4): глаголы в прошедшем времени по чтению -ed.
steps: AB 2: My family and I really enjoy watching films together. We also cook and go for walks.

Reader 1.1: American kids' favourite shows are The Simpsons and Rugrats. 1.2: the father; the mother; Marge's son; Bart's sister; Lisa's sister. 1.3: They like Homer because when he does something silly, he says «Doh!». 1.4: AE favorite — BE favourite. 1.5: [ʌ] funny, lucky, but; [juː] blue, music, cute; [ɔː] because, laugh.
AB 1: [t] danced, walked, worked, watched, helped; [d] stayed, lived, travelled, played, enjoyed; [ɪd] visited, wanted; irregular: went, had, saw.
problems.answer: Семейные занятия; Симпсоны; favorite/favourite; чтение -ed

chapters.title: Unit 1: Let's make friends! Lesson 3: How I spent my summer holidays

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 3, упр. 1, с. 10. 1) Прочитай диалог: где Клэр и Пол провели каникулы? 2) Ответь на вопросы Клэр и Пола.
steps: 1) Paul was at home, but Clare visited Brighton. Paul played tennis and rode his bike. Clare swam in the sea and went on trips.
2) Yes, I did. / No, I didn't. I walked, visited friends, swam in the sea, visited my grandparents, played football.
problems.answer: Пол — дома, Клэр — в Брайтоне; ответы о себе

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 3, упр. 2, с. 10. 1) Заполни пропуски в рассказах о каникулах глаголами в Past Simple. 2) Ты так же провёл(а) каникулы? Что делал(а), что не делал(а)?
steps: 1) rode, did, played, watched, was, didn't want, was, fished, swam, had, visited, saw, helped, didn't like, was.
2) I also rode my bike. I didn't fish. I also swam in the river. I didn't visit the seaside.
problems.answer: rode, did, played, watched, was, didn't want, fished, swam, had, visited, saw, helped; I also … / I didn't …

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 3, упр. 3, с. 11. AB 1.1–1.2 (с. 5): впиши глаголы в песню и проверь по записи.
steps: went, was, went, wore, played, was.
problems.answer: went, was, went, wore, played, was

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 3, упр. 4, с. 12. Проанализируй диаграмму и опиши данные.
steps: 20 kids went to a city, town or village. 15 kids visited relatives. 16 kids helped parents or grandparents. 4 kids went abroad. 10 kids went to a camp. 8 kids stayed at home.
problems.answer: … kids went / visited / helped / stayed …

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 3, упр. 5, с. 12. Посмотри на картинку Клэр: что она делала летом? Хорошо ли она провела время?
steps: She read a book, listened to the radio, played with a ball, walked in the mountains, worked in the garden and swam in the lake.
Yes, she had a great time in summer.
problems.answer: Читала, слушала радио, играла, гуляла в горах, работала в саду — отлично провела лето

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 3, упр. 6, с. 12. AB 2 (с. 6): впиши недостающие слова в вопросы и задай их одноклассникам.
steps: Did you travel? a) Did you go abroad? b) Where did you go? c) Did you like it?
Did you visit relatives? a) Where do they live? b) What did you do there?
Did you help your parents? a) What did you do? b) Did you like it?
Итог: 5 classmates travelled, 8 visited relatives, 10 helped parents.
problems.answer: Вопросы Did you …? Where / What did you …? + итоги опроса

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 3, упр. 7, с. 12. AB 3.1–3.2 (с. 7): расписание Пола — что делал и не делал; о себе. Reader 2: стишок Джилл о ярмарке.
steps: AB 3.1: On Monday he swam in the pool. On Tuesday he didn't write a letter to Tom. On Wednesday he bought a present. On Thursday he didn't watch a film. On Friday he went to a birthday party. On Saturday he rode a bike.
AB 3.2: Last week I swam in the pool, wrote a letter, watched a film. I didn't buy a present, didn't go to a party.

Reader 2.1: Yes, Jill liked the country fair. 2.2–2.3: At the fair Jill saw horses, a parade, a clown; she ate lemonade and candy. 2.4: [eɪ] hey, today, lemonade, parade; [əʊ] low, no; [aʊ] country, around, down, clown; [eə] fair, there. 2.5: mum (BE) — mom (AE).
problems.answer: Расписание Пола в Past Simple; о себе; стишок о ярмарке

chapters.title: Unit 1: Let's make friends! Lesson 4: Welcome to my school!

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 4, упр. 1, с. 13. Послушай диалог: в какую школу ходит Клэр и что она будет изучать?
steps: 1.1) Clare goes to Springfield School. She is in the first form (of secondary school).
1.2) Clare tells Daniel that she will learn Science, Geography, Technology, Maths and some other subjects.
problems.answer: Springfield School; Science, Geography, Technology, Maths

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 4, упр. 2, с. 13. 1) По таблице скажи, что ещё будет изучать Клэр. 2) Что будешь / не будешь изучать ты в 5 классе? 3) Ответь на вопросы.
steps: 2.1) Except Science, Geography, Technology and Maths, Clare will learn English, French, History, Music, Art and PE.
2.2) In the fifth form I will learn Russian, Literature, Maths, English, History, Geography, Biology, Music, Art and PE. I won't learn French.
2.3) We'll have English three times a week. We'll have Maths five times a week.
problems.answer: Предметы Клэр; свои предметы с will / won't

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 4, упр. 3, с. 14. 1) По календарю скажи, что будут делать дети. 2) Что будет / не будет у вас в школе? 3) Какие интересные события ждут тебя в этой четверти?
steps: 3.1) On September 8th the children will celebrate going back to school. On September 21st they will compete with teachers in tennis. On October 5th they will watch a play. On October 20th they will have a party.
3.2) At my school we will celebrate going back to school. We won't compete with teachers in tennis. We will watch a play.
3.3) This term we will plant trees near our school in September. We will take part in a football competition in October.
problems.answer: will / won't + события школьного календаря

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 4, упр. 4, с. 15. 1) Составь вопросы о вечеринке после урока. 2) Послушай, как ученики собираются праздновать.
steps: 4.1) Will you have the party? Will you decorate the classroom? Will you have fun? Will you invite your friends? Will you play games?
4.2) They will have a party. They'll bring a lot of CDs. They'll make sandwiches. Tom will buy biscuits and chocolate. They'll dance.
problems.answer: Will you …? + планы: bring CDs, make sandwiches, buy biscuits

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 4, упр. 5, с. 15. AB 1: Клэр скоро поедет во Францию — напиши письмо и задай ей вопросы.
steps: When will Clare go to France? Will she travel by train? Where will she stay? What cities will she visit? Will she speak French? What will she see?
problems.answer: Вопросы с will о поездке во Францию

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 4, упр. 6, с. 15. AB 3 (с. 121): запиши расписание и дополни предложения. Reader 3: история из книги Беверли Клири «Эллен Тэббитс».
steps: AB 3: In the 5th form I'll learn Russian, Maths, English, History … I'll have English three times a week.

Reader 3.1: b. 3.2: 3. 3.3: An exhibition of pupils' works, a band performance, folk dances, a coffee break, a pantomime and a play will be at the school party. 3.4: AE Math — BE Maths; AE a sixth-grader — BE a sixth-former; AE fall — BE autumn.
problems.answer: Расписание; Reader: b, 3, программа праздника, AE/BE

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 4, Reading lesson, с. 15. Reader 4: стихотворение об играх с мячом после школы.
steps: R4.1: park, a swim, park, go, candy, ball, went, go, park, go, ball, game, run. Children played with the ball.
R4.2: First the children came to the pool. Then they went to the shop. After that they met Kent. Finally they played in the park.
R4.3: Three children came to the pool: Kate, Jim and Clark. Five children went to the shop: Kate, Jim, Clark, Mark and Kent.
R4.4: How many people were in each group? — Two groups, three players in each.
R4.5: Clark, Kate and Jim met Mark at the pool.
R4.6: We have a «Hit and Run» game: players of one team throw a ball at the players of the other team. We also play football, volleyball and basketball.
problems.answer: Порядок событий, имена детей, игры с мячом

chapters.title: Unit 1: Let's make friends! Lesson 5: I've got a new friend!

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 5, упр. 1, с. 16. Катя — ученица по обмену, проводит выходные с семьёй Дуглас. 1) О чём говорят Элейн и Катя? 2) Прочитай диалог.
steps: 1) Elaine and Katya are talking about Katya's family.
2) Elaine: What city are you from, Katya? — Katya: I'm from Lipetsk. Look, these are pictures of my family. — Elaine: Who's this? — Katya: This is my brother.
problems.answer: Разговор о семье Кати

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 5, упр. 2, с. 16. Составь из реплик два диалога.
steps: Dialogue 1: Katya: These are some pictures of my family. Would you like to see them? — Clare: Oh, yes. Who's this? — Katya: This is my mum. — Clare: What does she do? — Katya: She's a teacher.
Dialogue 2: Jay: Have you got any brothers or sisters? — Katya: Yes, I've got a brother. — Jay: How old is he? — Katya: He's fifteen.
problems.answer: Два диалога о семье

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 5, упр. 3, с. 17. Заполни диалог подходящими фразами и запиши его.
steps: Stuart: What's your name? — You: My name is Sasha. Where do you live? — Stuart: I live in Bristol. What about you? — You: I live in Kazan. — Stuart: How old are you? — You: I'm eleven. — Stuart: Have you got any pets? — You: Yes, I've got a dog.
problems.answer: Диалог-знакомство со Стюартом

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 5, упр. 4, с. 17. 1) Представь, что ты гостишь у семьи Дуглас; поговори с Джеем. 2) Расскажи родителям Джея о себе.
steps: 1) Jay: How old are you? — You: I'm 10. How old are you? — Jay: I'm 15. What form are you in? — You: I'm in the 5th form. — Jay: What's your hobby? — You: I like drawing.
2) My name is Sasha. I'm 10. I live in Moscow, Russia. I am in the 5th form. My favourite subject is Art. In my free time I draw and play football.
problems.answer: Диалог с Джеем + рассказ о себе

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 5, упр. 5, с. 17. AB 1 (с. 10): выбери правильные варианты. AB 2.1–2.2: свой адрес и письмо другу по переписке.
steps: AB 1: b, a, c, b, c, b.
AB 2.1: Flat 121, 15 Tverskaya Street, Moscow, Russia.
AB 2.2: Dear English friend, Hi! My name is Alex Ivanov. I'm 11. I live in Moscow. I'm in the 5th form. My hobby is football. I've got a dog. Please write to me. Best wishes, Alex.
problems.answer: b, a, c, b, c, b; адрес; письмо другу

problems.condition: Unit 1, Consolidation, с. 17 (AB с. 11–14). Грамматика: формы глаголов, неправильные глаголы, Past и Future Simple, предлоги, ошибки.
steps: AB 1: doing, reads, likes, went, will visit.
AB 2 (лишняя форма): got, be, sing, went, have.
AB 3: 15 неправильных глаголов в головоломке: came, had, went, took, saw, did, was, were, made, got, ran, swam, read, wrote, gave.
AB 4.1: listened, stayed, travelled, were, rode, swam. AB 4.2: will go, will spend, will play, will swim, will visit.
AB 5: on, on, in, on, At, On, in, in, to, by.
AB 6: исправляем ошибки: He didn't go (not «didn't went»); She will visit (not «will visits»); We were (not «was»).
problems.answer: Формы глаголов, 15 неправильных, Past/Future Simple, предлоги

chapters.title: Unit 1: Let's make friends! Lesson 6: Doing a project is interesting!

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 6, с. 18. Дети в Британии делают проекты на разные темы. Прочитай о проектах и выбери свой.
steps: Проект 1 «My favourite subjects»: напишем о предметах, придумаем значки для каждого.
Проект 2 «All about me»: рассказ о себе и семье с фото.
Проект 3 «My summer holidays»: рассказ о лете с рисунками.
problems.answer: Три темы проекта на выбор

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 6, упр. 1, с. 19. Подготовь один из проектов: 1) любимые предметы; 2) всё обо мне; 3) летние каникулы.
steps: 1) I am in the 5th form and I learn Russian, Maths, Literature, PE, Art, Music, History, Biology and English. My favourite subjects are English and Art.
2) Hello, my name is Dima. I'm in the 5th form. I have a big family: mother, father, two sisters and a dog. My hobby is chess.
3) On summer holidays I like visiting other cities with my family. I also like swimming in rivers and lakes. Last summer I went to Sochi.
problems.answer: Текст проекта по выбранной теме

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 6, упр. 2, с. 19. Выступи с проектом перед классом и ответь на вопросы одноклассников.
steps: Представляем проект: This is my project «My favourite subjects». I am in the 5th form and I learn … My favourite subject is … because …
Отвечаем на вопросы: Why do you like English? — Because I want to travel.
problems.answer: Презентация проекта + ответы на вопросы

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 6, упр. 3, с. 19. Обсудите проекты и выберите лучший.
steps: I think Dima's project is the best because it is interesting and has a lot of pictures. Which project do you like best?
problems.answer: I think …'s project is the best because …

chapters.title: Unit 1: Let's make friends! Lessons 7-8: Test yourself

problems.condition: Unit 1, Test yourself I, с. 20 (AB с. 15). Послушай разговор Клэр и Кэти о летних каникулах Кэти и отметь T/F.
steps: T, T, T, F, T, F, F.
problems.answer: T, T, T, F, T, F, F

problems.condition: Unit 1, Test yourself II, с. 20 (AB с. 15). Прочитай факты о школах Британии и США: на какие вопросы есть ответы в тексте?
steps: How long is the school year? — есть для обеих стран. When does the school year start? — Британия: сентябрь, США: август/сентябрь. What subjects do pupils learn? — есть. Do pupils wear uniforms? — Британия: да, США: обычно нет.
problems.answer: Таблица: вопрос — Британия ✔ — США ✔

problems.condition: Unit 1, Test yourself III, с. 20 (AB с. 16). 1) Лексика: соедини глаголы и слова. 2) Грамматика: заполни пропуски правильной формой глагола (рассказ Пола о каникулах).
steps: 2) spend, were, had, swam, fished, rode, visited, will go.
problems.answer: Лексика: a/h, c, g/i, b, f, e, d; грамматика: spend, were, had, swam, fished, rode

problems.condition: Unit 1, Test yourself IV, с. 20. 1) Международный лагерь: разыграй знакомство в паре. 2) Расскажи о себе.
steps: 1) — What is your name? — My name is Sally. What is your name? — My name is Sasha. How old are you? — I'm 10. What's your hobby? — Tennis.
2) My name is Marina. I am 12 years old. I am from Moscow, Russia. I am the youngest in my family. My mum works in a bank, my dad is a driver. My hobby is dancing.
problems.answer: Диалог-знакомство + рассказ о себе

problems.condition: Unit 1, Test yourself V, с. 21. Напиши письмо, чтобы найти друга по переписке.
steps: My name is Sasha. I am 11 years old. I'm from Russia. I am the eldest in the family. My dad is a vet and my mum is a teacher. I like reading and football. Last summer I went to the seaside. I'd like to have a penfriend from Britain. Please write to me!
problems.answer: Письмо о себе для друга по переписке

problems.condition: Unit 1, Test yourself VI, с. 22. Как много ты знаешь о культуре Англии и Америки? Ответь на вопросы.
steps: 1) Geography, Science, Art, PE and Technology. 2) Halloween and Christmas. 3) Brighton, Disneyland. 4) Scrabble and Monopoly. 5) The Simpsons.
problems.answer: Предметы, праздники, места, игры, шоу

problems.condition: Unit 1, Test yourself VII, с. 22. Прочитай слова и скажи, какие ты понимаешь и умеешь употреблять.
steps: Words: a cousin — двоюродный брат/сестра; difficult — трудный; either — тоже (в отриц.); spare time — свободное время; a trip — поездка; abroad — за границей; a fair — ярмарка; a form — класс.
Word combinations: to go on a trip, to have a picnic, to take photos, to ride a bike, to spend holidays.
problems.answer: Список слов и словосочетаний Unit 1

problems.condition: Unit 1, Test yourself VIII, с. 22 (AB IV, с. 17). Пройди самопроверку по таблице.
steps: Exercises I found difficult were with Past Simple and Future Simple. I can talk about my family and hobbies. I can write a letter to a penfriend. I need to practise irregular verbs.
problems.answer: Самооценка: что получилось, что нужно повторить

chapters.title: Unit 2: Rules around us Lesson 1: Why do we all follow the rules?

problems.condition: Unit 2, Lesson 1, упр. 1, с. 24. 1) Что сказал полицейский детям? 2) Какие правила более строгие? 3) Что ты думаешь об этих правилах?
steps: 1) The police officer told the children that they should be careful with strangers and not leave the house without their parents' permission.
2) More strict: I must be very cautious of strangers. I mustn't go anywhere alone. I must follow Internet safety rules. Less strict: I should check with my parents.
3) I must be cautious of strangers — it is fair. I mustn't go anywhere alone — it is a bit strict, but useful.
problems.answer: Правила безопасности: must / mustn't / should + своё мнение

problems.condition: Unit 2, Lesson 1, упр. 2, с. 25. 1) Прочитай хэллоуинские правила безопасности и заполни пропуски. 2) Проверь по записи.
steps: Think about your safety. Follow special rules. Check with your parents before you go. Never go alone. Don't eat sweets before your parents check them. Wear light clothes.
problems.answer: safety, follow, check, alone, sweets, light
